newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums ease, Asia arb closes.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums ease, Asia arb closes.

text.p: European jet fuel cargo premiums weakened on abundant supply on Monday but those for barges were stable, traders said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures slid 50 cents to $222 a tonne following a weak NYMEX opening that partially retraced a recent rally.

Cargoes were offered at around Jan IPE +30, around $2 lower. Barges were stable to slightly weaker at Jan IPE +$25. The Med was steady at around fob Med high +$5/6. The arb to Asia was closed by the screen rally and a sharp gain in shipping rates, traders said.
